## This repository does not accept pull requests

Road to ML is **maintainer-curated**. Content PRs are not reviewed or merged.

Please close this PR and read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

**To report a typo, broken link, or factual error:** open a [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/NabidAlam/road-to-machine-learning/issues/new) instead.

Thank you for your interest in the curriculum.
